# terrakube_module (Data Source)

Looks up a private registry module by name and provider within a Terrakube organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "terrakube_organization" "org" {
  name = "my-organization"
}

data "terrakube_module" "vpc" {
  organization_id = data.terrakube_organization.org.id
  name            = "vpc"
  provider_name   = "aws"
}

output "module_source" {
  value = data.terrakube_module.vpc.source
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Module name
- `organization_id` (String) Terrakube organization ID
- `provider_name` (String) Module provider name. Example: azurerm, google, aws, etc

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Module description
- `folder` (String) Folder of the module inside the repository
- `id` (String) Module ID
- `source` (String) Source repository of the module
- `ssh_id` (String) SSH connection ID, null when the module does not use one
- `tag_prefix` (String) Tag prefix for mono-repository modules
- `vcs_id` (String) VCS connection ID, null when the module does not use one
